cases.name: first_page_review_is_full
cases.situation: A page has not been reviewed before.

cases.name: small_amendment_uses_delta_review
cases.situation: An amendment changes only one finding and its directly affected layout.

cases.name: structural_amendment_upgrades_to_full_review
cases.situation: An amendment changes page mapping, state mapping, primary layout, or asset source.

cases.name: unchanged_figma_evidence_is_reused
cases.situation: The Figma node, URL, design version, and relevant implementation area are unchanged.

cases.name: unexpected_duplicate_or_blank_asset_blocks_layout
cases.situation: Distinct design nodes export identical bytes unexpectedly, or an asset is blank.

cases.name: sample_state_must_not_be_hardcoded
cases.situation: A supplied screenshot shows selected sample data but the real state model has no default selection.

cases.name: visible_p2_blocks_acceptance
cases.situation: A P2 finding is visible or functional in a supplied design state.

cases.name: minor_p3_is_recorded
cases.situation: A P3 finding has no clipping, overlap, repeated geometry, or state inconsistency and pixel fidelity was not requested.

cases.name: two_no_progress_waits_trigger_recovery
cases.situation: A worker produces no message or file change across two consecutive waits.

cases.name: unchanged_external_failure_is_not_retried
cases.situation: A Figma or build operation failed externally and its inputs and environment did not change.
